summary: Searchable multiple selection: chosen values appear as removable chips below the field and the list stays open while selecting.
whenToUse: Choosing multiple values from a medium or long list.
Recipients, skills, tags from a controlled vocabulary.
whenNotToUse: A few always-visible options: use CheckboxGroup.
Free-form values not in a list: use TextField + TagGroup.

props.name: inputValue / defaultInputValue / onInputChange
props.description: Search text; cleared after each selection.

props.name: filter
props.description: local: filters options by label; none: the consumer passes already filtered results (async).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Message shown when there are no results.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint inside the input (does not replace the label).

props.name: inputRef / className / style
props.description: Access to the input and container customization.

keyboard.action: Adds or removes the focused option; the list stays open.
Moves to the chips and removes the focused one.

accessibility: Input following the APG Combobox pattern; options with aria-selected and a checkmark.
Chips are a labeled TagGroup (“Elementi selezionati”) with named remove buttons.
While the list is open, the rest of the page, chips included, is hidden from assistive technologies as the pattern prescribes.
responsive: Chips wrap below the field without reducing the typing area.
customization: className/style on the container; chips and list use the Tag and ListBox tokens.
commonMistakes: With filter="none", forgetting to update options based on inputValue.
Using different keys for the same option across subsequent requests.
limits: Selected keys not present in options display String(key) as their label.
